units.source_text: 但闻右近说道：“唉，我想睡了。

en.t: Then Ukon was heard saying, "Ah, I am sleepy.

units.source_text: 昨夜也不知不觉地做到了天亮。

en.t: Last night too, I worked without noticing until dawn.

units.source_text: 这一点留到明天早上再缝也来得及。

en.t: It will still be in time if I sew this part tomorrow morning.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人虽然性急，放来迎接的车子总要日高时分才到。”

en.t: Although the wife of the Governor of Hitachi is impatient, the carriage sent to fetch us will not arrive until the sun is high."

units.source_text: 便将缝物收起，把帷屏挂好，横卧着打起瞌睡来。

en.t: She then put away the sewing, hung the curtain screen properly, lay down on her side, and began to doze.

units.source_text: 浮舟也走进内室去睡觉了。

en.t: Ukifune also went into the inner room to sleep.

units.source_text: 右近站起身，到北面自己房中去转了一转，立刻回来，躺在小姐近旁睡觉了。

en.t: Ukon got up, went for a moment to her own room on the north side, came back at once, and lay down near the young lady to sleep.

units.source_text: 侍女们都已想睡，不久大家都睡着了。

en.t: The waiting women were all already sleepy, and before long everyone had fallen asleep.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看到这光景，觉得没有其他办法，便轻轻地敲打格子门。

en.t: Prince Niou saw this state of affairs, realized there was no other way, and gently tapped on the lattice door.

units.source_text: 右近听见了，问道：“是谁？”

en.t: Ukon heard it and asked, "Who is there?"

units.source_text: 匂亲王咳嗽两声。

en.t: Prince Niou cleared his throat twice.

units.source_text: 右近觉得这声音是贵人口吻，以为是薰大将回来了，便起身走出去。

en.t: Ukon felt the voice had the tone of a nobleman, thought General Kaoru had returned, and got up to go out.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在门外说道：“先把这门打开！”

en.t: From outside the door, Prince Niou said, "Open this door first!"

units.source_text: 右近答道：“真奇怪，想不到大人在这时候回来，夜已经很深了！”

en.t: Ukon answered, "How strange, I never expected you to return at this hour; the night is already very late!"

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“仲信告诉我说：小姐明天要出门。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "Nakanobu told me that the young lady is going out tomorrow.

units.source_text: 我吃了一惊，连忙赶回来看。

en.t: I was startled and hurried back to see her.

units.source_text: 想不到在路上出了些事情。

en.t: Unexpectedly, something happened on the way.

units.source_text: 快开门吧！”

en.t: Open the door quickly!"

units.source_text: 这声音很像薰大将，因为说得很轻，不易辨别，

en.t: The voice sounded very much like General Kaoru's, and because it was spoken so softly, it was hard to distinguish,

units.source_text: 所以右近全然想不到是另一人，便把门打开。

en.t: so Ukon never imagined it was another person and opened the door.

units.source_text: 匂亲王进了门，又低声说道：“我在路上碰到了很可怕的事情，

en.t: Prince Niou came through the door and again said in a low voice, "I met with something terrible on the road,

units.source_text: 服装弄得奇奇怪怪，你不要把灯点得太亮了。”

en.t: and my clothing has become very strange, so do not make the lamp too bright."

units.source_text: 右近说道：“哎呀！真可怕啊！”

en.t: Ukon said, "Oh my! How frightening!"

units.source_text: 她战战兢兢地把灯火移开。

en.t: Trembling with fear, she moved the lamp aside.

units.source_text: 匂亲王叮嘱她：“不要让别人看到我，也不要叫人知道我回来了。”

en.t: Prince Niou warned her, "Do not let anyone see me, and do not let anyone know I have returned."

units.source_text: 真亏他想得周到。

en.t: He had really thought it through carefully.

units.source_text: 他的声音本来和薰大将很相像，

en.t: His voice already sounded very much like General Kaoru's,

units.source_text: 此时又用心模仿薰大将的态度，竟混进内室去了。

en.t: and now he carefully imitated General Kaoru's manner as well, and actually slipped into the inner room.

units.source_text: 右近听见他说“在路上碰到了很可怕的事情”，

en.t: Ukon had heard him say that he had met with something terrible on the road,

units.source_text: 不知弄得怎么样了，很是担心，就伏在隐处窥看。

en.t: and not knowing what state he was in, she was very worried and crouched in a hidden place to peer in.

units.source_text: 但见他装束整齐而华丽，衣香之浓烈不逊于薰大将。

en.t: But she saw that he was neatly and splendidly dressed, and the rich fragrance of his robes was no less than General Kaoru's.

units.source_text: 他走近浮舟身边，脱下衣服，装作习惯的样子躺下去。

en.t: He went close to Ukifune, took off his outer clothing, and lay down as though it were his usual habit.

units.source_text: 右近说道：“请到以前住的那个房间里去吧。”

en.t: Ukon said, "Please go to the room where you stayed before."

units.source_text: 匂亲王不答。

en.t: Prince Niou did not answer.

units.source_text: 右近便把衾枕送上，叫起睡着了的侍女来，大家退往那边去睡了。

en.t: Ukon then brought bedding and pillows, woke the sleeping waiting women, and they all withdrew over there to sleep.

units.source_text: 随从人员向来不是归侍女们招待的，所以她们绝不怀疑。

en.t: Attendants were never the responsibility of the waiting women to receive, so they did not suspect anything at all.

units.source_text: 还有自作聪明的人说：“这么夜深时分特地赶来，情义真重啊！

en.t: There was even someone acting clever who said, "To come all this way at such a late hour shows truly deep feeling!

units.source_text: 小姐恐怕不知道他这一片好心吧。”

en.t: The young lady probably does not know how kind his intentions are."

units.source_text: 右近说：“喂，静些！

en.t: Ukon said, "Hush, be quiet!

units.source_text: 夜静时分低声说话反而听得清楚。”

en.t: When the night is quiet, whispering can actually be heard more clearly."

units.source_text: 于是大家都睡着了。

en.t: After that, everyone fell asleep.

units.source_text: 浮舟发觉来的不是薰大将，惊惶万状，不知所措。

en.t: Ukifune realized that the man who had come was not General Kaoru, and she was utterly terrified and did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王默不作声。

en.t: But Prince Niou remained silent.

units.source_text: 他在人目昭彰的地方尚且肆无忌惮，

en.t: Even in places where many eyes were watching, he had acted without restraint,

units.source_text: 此时更加不顾一切了。

en.t: and now he was even more reckless.

units.source_text: 浮舟如果最初就知道不是薰大将，多少总可设法拒绝。

en.t: If Ukifune had known from the beginning that he was not General Kaoru, she might have found some way to refuse him.

units.source_text: 但现在毫无办法，只觉得像做梦一般。

en.t: But now there was nothing she could do, and it felt only like a dream.

units.source_text: 匂亲王渐渐开口说话，

en.t: Prince Niou gradually began to speak,

units.source_text: 向她诉说上次不得相亲之恨，以及别后相思之苦。

en.t: telling her of his resentment that he could not be close to her last time and of the pain of longing after they parted.

units.source_text: 浮舟此时才知道是匂亲王。

en.t: Only then did Ukifune realize that it was Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 她越发觉得可耻，想起将来被姐姐知道了如何是好，

en.t: She felt all the more ashamed, and when she thought what would happen if her elder sister learned of it someday,

units.source_text: 痛苦万状，只管哭个不住。

en.t: her anguish was beyond measure, and she could do nothing but keep crying.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想起今后无法和她再会面，反而悲伤起来，也陪着她哭了。

en.t: Prince Niou thought that he would no longer be able to meet her after this, grew sad in turn, and cried along with her.
